title.narrative: Co-creating Green Safe Space: Tackling Polarization through Youth-led Sustainable Food Production

description.narrative: The project arose from two preparatory events jointly conducted by RETZ and 4H: the Pilot Identification Project and Preparatory Study. The primary objective of this pilot initiative is to acquire and establish a small-scale demonstration farm plot in Zimbabwe, serving as a central hub for project activities. These activities include experimentation with climate friendly sustainable food systems, collaborative learning and sharing of best practices in food production and providing support for entrepreneurial and advocacy efforts led by local youth aged 15-30 associated with RETZ as members or volunteers. Additionally, the project aims to create a safe and inclusive space for dialogue on issues of polarization and community-building, amplifying the voices of local youth. The established farm plot will serve as a sustainable platform to enhance the practical and theoretical understanding of climate smart sustainable food systems and rural challenges among young people, enabling them to effectively disseminate knowledge within their peer groups and neighboring communities.
